messages:
Ravi (Support): @Nora FYI OpalCare trial onboarding blocked by repeated embed 502s since this morning. They want ETA before renewal check in 3 weeks.
Nora (CSM): thanks Ravi. paste minimal logs + last-success time? tagging Renewals after.
Ravi (Support): logs: ```2024-07-12T08:21:11Z ERROR embed-ingest 502 req=aa11bb user=opal-742 model=redwood-embed-v2```
Ravi (Support): last good ingest 2024-07-09. spike at 08:20-08:30 UTC.
Iris (Enablement): I can run a 30m guided reingest session tomorrow. Recommend pause concurrent bulk jobs, run small pilot slice.
Tobias (SRE): quick triage: proxy queueing for tenant. short-term: apply per-tenant batch cap & retry-backoff. I'll test on staging.
IncBot: Incident INC-20240712-OPAL opened, assigned to Tobias.
Nora (CSM): classify as onboarding-blocker, renewal-risk=high. Draft comms to customer: we opened a high-priority incident, will run triage + guided reingest, ETA 24-72h. Approve?
Liam (Renewals): please cc renewals and note we may offer credit/extension if unresolved at check-in.
Ravi (Support): noted. I'll attach repro script and link to logs.
Tobias (SRE): staging test with reduced batch size looks good. plan to deploy temp cap in prod and monitor 30m.
Iris (Enablement): booked enablement session for 11:00 PT after triage; will share checklist and capture steps for playbook.
Nora (CSM): owners: Nora->external comms + renewal flag; Iris->enablement; Ravi->repro + customer coord; Tobias->triage + mitigation; Liam->renewal contingency.
IncBot: INC-20240712-OPAL status=triage priority=high.
Tobias (SRE): temp cap deployed for opal-742, test payloads successful. Monitoring ongoing.
Nora (CSM): sending comms to customer and scheduling internal 15m postmortem after stabilization. Keeping thread as single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
